preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n numbers, one for each vertex.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(j, int) and j >= 0 for j in result)
postconditions.description: Each dominant index j is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(j == max(range(len(depths[i])), key=lambda k: depths[i][k]) for i, j in enumerate(result))
postconditions.description: Each dominant index j for vertex i is the index of the maximum value in its depth array.
